stem: Container-mass tracking shows steady water loss, but one embedded moisture sensor reports almost no dryback for several days. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Prioritize the electronic sensor because continuous measurements are more representative than repeated container-mass records
Increase irrigation frequency because the sensor indicates water content is staying high in the measured location
Discard the mass trend because changes in plant biomass make container measurements unsuitable for dryback assessment
Verify sensor placement and function and compare repeat measurements before changing the irrigation program
rationale: Conflicting measurements should trigger verification. Sensor placement or function can produce unrepresentative readings, so a management change should wait until the discrepancy is resolved.
